Game Overview

In Neon Ghost, the core idea is straightforward: embark on a pulse-pounding adventure in Neon Ghost, where you are a cyberpunk mercenary in a dystopian world. Customize your character, master formidable weapons, and face rogue robots in intense combat. Discover a gripping narrative while honing your skills to become an unstoppable force.

How to Play

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Neon Ghost is easy to pick up. Embark on a pulse-pounding adventure in Neon Ghost, where you are a cyberpunk mercenary in a dystopian world. Customize your character, master formidable weapons, and face rogue robots in intense combat. Discover a gripping narrative while honing your skills to become an unstoppable force.
